purpose: Evidence-backed capability notes for model detection and safe UI/backend gating. This is research data, not yet runtime-integrated.

evidence_policy.sku_variation_warning: A marketing family may contain white, 4-zone RGB, or 24-zone RGB variants. Do not infer a capability for an unobserved SKU.

field_types.bios_prefixes: string[] — first 4 chars of the Lenovo BIOS id (e.g. Q6CN); [] means not yet verified, never guess
field_types.family: enum: legion-5 | legion-5-pro | legion-5p | legion-pro-5 | legion-7 | legion-pro-7 | legion-9 | legion-s7 | legion-slim-5 | loq-15 | ideapad-gaming-3
field_types.generation: int (5..10); string "N_or_M" marks families spanning generations — disambiguate by machine type
field_types.capabilities.keyboard_backlight: enum: white_only | 24_zone_rgb | four_zone_rgb | per_key_rgb | spectrum_rgb | white_or_24_zone_rgb | white_or_four_zone_rgb | sku_variant | unknown — original free-text observation preserved in keyboard_backlight_note
field_types.capabilities.rgb_zones: int; string (e.g. "24_zone_optional", "unknown_per_sku") = SKU-dependent — treat as unknown
field_types.capabilities.rgb_protocol: enum: none | unknown | legacy_4zone | wmi_backlight | spectrum | per_sku — original free-text observation (incl. HID ids) preserved in rgb_protocol_note
field_types.capabilities.fan_rpm_backend: descriptive slug (legion_laptop_ec | lenovo_wmi_other | wmi3_expected | yogafan_read_only | ec_fallback | unknown*); an expected_* suffix means inferred, not live-verified
field_types.capabilities.fan_control: bool where live-verified; descriptive slug where inferred/unknown

schema.normalization: 2026-09-01: rgb_protocol and keyboard_backlight were normalized from free text to enums; every original value is preserved verbatim in the matching *_note field.

The catalog is intentionally not exhaustive; unknown models must use live probing and an unknown capability state.
82JW/82JK/82JQ/82JF/82K6 additions are PSREF ShowModel + PSREF PDF official high confidence; per-MTM BIOS remains family-level until live dmidecode telemetry confirms exact prefix.
Gen6 PPT is GodMode V1 gated (GKCN>=46/H1CN>=39), not WMI3_clamped as on LOQ Gen8; do not probe WMI3 on GKCN/H1CN below gate.
16ACH6 vs 16ACH6H TGP distinction is intentional (3050/Ti only vs 3060/3070); do not apply H-variant TGP to non-H product key.
LOQ 15IRH8/16APH8 PSREF lists White/Blue/4-Zone RGB SKU variant; live MT table 403 Akamai-gated so per-MTM enumeration remains unverified; treat as family pattern low confidence.

FSCN/EFCN remain family-level BIOS prefixes; exact BIOS versions, keyboard controllers, PPT, and smart amp remain unknown.
